layer_selection: Max mean bidirectional donor-directed contrast over discovery pairs, separately per family/component. Residual excludes layer17 (trivial terminal readout control); value_bus excludes layer17 (no downstream consumers). Attention includes17. No individual pair selection.
transfer: All transfer pairs at frozen component-specific layer.
scope: Attention write or residual last position only; entire persistent value bus by aligned positions only when donor/recipient token lengths match. Other upstream states remain recipient-native. Bus injection occurs after the patched layer attention, influencing only later attention. The scopes differ and are not equal-size replacements.
hypotheses: Attention or residual patches carry substantially more binding/copying contrast than previously selected MLP writes.
Correct task donors produce greater changes than nuisance donors.
Persistent raw-value bus is sufficient to transmit some task change.
precision: float32 compute after bfloat16-rounded shared loader
